item.text: Trivy supplies a per-source `VendorSeverity` map and a per-source CVSS map. I’ll use the union of those source names, keep the selected severity as a fallback for its own source, and retain distinct entries when the same CVE appears in multiple targets.

The conversion and model changes are in place. I’m running the existing Trivy parser and model tests now; their expected results still use the old generic key, so I’ll update those fixtures to the source-specific shape.

import json,re
from pathlib import Path
path=Path('contrib/trivy/parser/v2/parser_test.go')
s=path.read_text()
reports={name:json.loads(data) for name,data in re.findall(r'var (\\w+Trivy) = \\[\\]byte\\("'`(.*?)`'"\\)',s,re.S)}
source_type={'debian':'TrivyDebian','nvd':'TrivyNVD','redhat':'TrivyRedHat','ubuntu':'TrivyUbuntu'}
changes=[]
for report_name, report in reports.items():
    expected_name=report_name.removesuffix('Trivy')+'SR'
    anchor='var '+expected_name+' = &models.ScanResult{'
    if anchor not in s: continue
    section_start=s.index(anchor)
    next_var=re.search(r'\\nvar \\w+\\s*=',s[section_start+len(anchor):])
    section_end=section_start+len(anchor)+next_var.start() if next_var else len(s)
    section=s[section_start:section_end]
    vulns={v['VulnerabilityID']:v for result in report['Results'] for v in result.get('Vulnerabilities') or []}
    for match in re.finditer(r'\\bCveID: \"(["'^"]+)"'"',section):
        cve=match.group(1)
        if cve not in vulns: continue
        content_match=re.search(r'CveContents: models\\.CveContents\\{',section[match.end():])
        if not content_match: continue
        start=match.end()+content_match.start()
        next_id=re.search(r'\\bCveID: \"',section[match.end():])
        if next_id and next_id.start()<content_match.start(): continue
        open_brace=section.index('{',start)
        depth=0; in_string=False; escape=False; end=None
        for i in range(open_brace,len(section)):
            ch=section[i]
            if in_string:
                if escape: escape=False
                elif ch=='\\\\': escape=True
                elif ch=='\"': in_string=False
            elif ch=='\"': in_string=True
            elif ch=='{': depth+=1
            elif ch=='}':
                depth-=1
                if depth==0:
                    end=i+1; break
        if end is None: raise RuntimeError('unmatched braces')
        v=vulns[cve]
        sources=set(v.get('CVSS',{})) | set(v.get('VendorSeverity',{}))
        selected=v.get('SeveritySource','')
        if selected: sources.add(selected)
        if not sources: sources={'unknown'}
        lines=['CveContents: models.CveContents{']
        for source in sorted(sources):
            typ=source_type.get(source,'TrivyUnknown')
            cvss=v.get('CVSS',{}).get(source,{})
            sev=v.get('VendorSeverity',{}).get(source,'')
            if not sev and selected==source: sev=v.get('Severity','')
            if not sev and cvss.get('V3Score',0)>0:
                score=cvss['V3Score']; sev='CRITICAL' if score>=9 else 'HIGH' if score>=7 else 'MEDIUM' if score>=4 else 'LOW'
            lines.append(f'\\t\\t\\t\\tmodels.{typ}: {{')
            lines.append('\\t\\t\\t\\t\\t{')
            lines.append(f'\\t\\t\\t\\t\\t\\tType: models.{typ},')
            lines.append(f'\\t\\t\\t\\t\\t\\tCveID: {json.dumps(cve)},')
            for src,dst in [('V2Score','Cvss2Score'),('V2Vector','Cvss2Vector'),('V3Score','Cvss3Score'),('V3Vector','Cvss3Vector')]:
                if cvss.get(src): lines.append(f'\\t\\t\\t\\t\\t\\t{dst}: {json.dumps(cvss[src]) if isinstance(cvss[src],str) else cvss[src]},')
            if sev: lines.append(f'\\t\\t\\t\\t\\t\\tCvss3Severity: {json.dumps(sev)},')
            if v.get('References'):
                refs=', '.join('{Source: \"trivy\", Link: '+json.dumps(ref)+'}' for ref in v['References'])
                lines.append(f'\\t\\t\\t\\t\\t\\tReferences: models.References{{{refs}}},')
            if v.get('CweIDs'):
                lines.append('\\t\\t\\t\\t\\t\\tCweIDs: []string{'+', '.join(json.dumps(cwe) for cwe in v['CweIDs'])+'},')
            lines.extend(['\\t\\t\\t\\t\\t},','\\t\\t\\t\\t},'])
        lines.append('\\t\\t\\t}')
        changes.append((section_start+start,section_start+end,'\\n'.join(lines)))
assert len(changes)==7,len(changes)
for start,end,replacement in sorted(changes,reverse=True): s=s[:start]+replacement+s[end:]
path.write_text(s)
PY"
